Test data CLEANLY at the cheaper T=4 base (iter-5: T=4,f=16, hr=0.6174, had budget headroom) so more data completes real epochs. ONE KNOB vs iter-5: train_n 400 -> 800 (2x). HYPOTHESIS: doubling train data reduces overfit of the learned analysis filters, lifting hr above iter-5's 0.6174 (and toward/past iter-6's 0.6329); tests whether DATA is the remaining lever. All else = iter-5 (T=4, f=16, k=9, n_bumps=31, x_range=2.0, lambda=0.02, lr=9.6e-4, batch=2, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42).
